4. our parish sunday november 1st 2026 our lady help of christians, navan road parish, dublin 7 our parish all saints day-sunday 1st november 2026 all saints our sr. niamh galvin op “there appear to be many people who are not concerned about their souls, and indeed, how much thought do even those who believe give to life beyond this earthly existence? yet the destiny of our souls matters: the peace we long for; the purpose, the meaningfulness and the ‘why’ of our existence, are fundamental. st. paul asked; ‘who can separate us from the love of god?’ during this month of november, in fact each day of our lives, we are invited to be saints; and the readings and prayers of the mass for the solemnity of all saints , which is described as the ‘festival of the father’s city, the heavenly jerusalem’ where the ‘great array of our brothers and sisters already gives him, eternal praise,’ is filled with encouragement for us to strive after what we have been created for. all saints are our strength for our pilgrim way: lights in these dark days of winter and sources of hope and confidence, interceding for us and praying that god will win our souls and unite us with them at last, where we will see him as he really is. mass intentions sunday 1st november 6.30 p.m(sat vigil) rita murphy i. mark kelly i. catherine gorman i. birthday remembrance kay & ronnie knox i. 9.00 a.m. for the people of the parish 10.30 a.m. for all souls 12 noon niall redmond i. ) mass intentions sunday 8th november 6.30 p.m(sat vigil) patrick & abigail hackett i. jason hackett i. ). catherine gorman i. birthday remembrance raymond & úna sweeney i. ann hall i.
